summary.text: Earl Read is a Democratic state representative who has represented District 26 in the Rhode Island House of Representatives since January 7, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Earl Read earned a high school diploma from Cranston High School West in 1989, a bachelor's degree from the University of Rhode Island in 1996 and a master's degree from Roger Williams University in 2004.
His career experience includes working for the Warwick Police Department and as a criminal justice instructor.
